audit.scope: Read-only accessibility and usability audit of all 52 routes and 9 sheets/dialogs across viewports, themes, text scaling, reduced motion, keyboard focus, and modal focus. No source code or git state modified.

axe.summary: Axe detected 1 critical violation (aria-required-parent) across all 52 routes with FloatingNav. Color contrast violations detected on 25 dark and 26 light routes. Specific routes trigger nested-interactive (quran/hifz, tools/hajj-live), scrollable-region-focusable (6 routes), and missing form labels (tools/zakat).

keyboardFocus.summary: Tab navigation reaches FloatingNav tabs and Retry button with visible focus outline (rgb(16, 16, 16) auto 1px). However, primary interactive cards in feed lack tabindex="0", skipping feed navigation via keyboard.

accessibleNamesRolesStates.summary: 25 interactive elements across 15 routes lack accessible names (unlabelled search inputs and textareas). 34 radio options in Settings omit required aria-checked. FloatingNav tabs omit aria-selected.

targetSize44px.summary: Over 340 interactive elements across routes fail the 44x44px minimum target size requirement. Top bar icon buttons (32x32px), modal close buttons (32x32px), pill chips (32-35px height), retry button (38px height), and search inputs (42px height) fail.

textScale130.summary: No horizontal overflow detected at 130% text scaling (docEl.scrollWidth === docEl.clientWidth). However, compact header badges and sub-captions in library, quran/home, and quran/reader exhibit text clipping/ellipsis overflow.

reducedMotion.summary: Browser correctly matches prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, but 0 CSS media rules for reduced motion are bundled in the stylesheets.

screenReaderHeaderOrder.summary: All 52 routes render multiple <h1> section headers without logical nesting (e.g. h2/h3).

floatingNavSemantics.summary: FloatingNav completely lacks landmark role="navigation", lacks parent role="tablist", and fails to set aria-selected or aria-current on active tab.

modalFocus.summary: React Native Web modal implementation correctly provides role="dialog", aria-modal="true", and traps keyboard focus within the dialog. Focus does not escape to background elements. However, inner modal controls contain axe and target size violations.

findings.title: FloatingNav tabs lack parent role="tablist" causing Critical ARIA violation on all routes
findings.wcag: WCAG 2.1 A 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
findings.expected: Any element with role="tab" must be contained within an ancestor element with role="tablist".
findings.actual: FloatingNav renders 4 tabs (<div role="tab"> for Home, Quran, Library, Tools) inside a container <div> that lacks role="tablist". Axe flags aria-required-parent as CRITICAL on every crawled route.

findings.title: FloatingNav lacks landmark role="navigation" and active tab state (aria-selected/aria-current)
findings.wcag: WCAG 2.1 A 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
findings.expected: Navigation bar has landmark role="navigation" and the active tab indicates active state with aria-selected="true" or aria-current="page".
findings.actual: The FloatingNav container has no role="navigation" or <nav> tag. The active tab has role="tab" but aria-selected and aria-current are both null/absent.

findings.title: Color contrast ratio falls below 4.5:1 on 25 dark routes and 26 light routes
findings.route: 25 routes in dark theme, 26 routes in light theme (e.g. quran/audio, quran/tafsir, quran/compare, library/downloads, tools/fasting)
findings.expected: Text and images of text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against their background (3:1 for large text).
findings.actual: Muted secondary text tokens (such as Arabic surah subtitles, edition identifiers, timestamps, and metadata pills) fail 4.5:1 threshold (measured between 2.1:1 and 3.8:1).

findings.title: Over 340 interactive touch targets measure below 44x44px minimum target size
findings.wcag: WCAG 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced), WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)
findings.expected: All interactive targets have an effective touch target size of at least 44x44 CSS pixels.
findings.actual: Widespread target size failures: Top header icon buttons (Notifications, Settings) measure 32x32px. Modal close buttons measure 32x32px. Pill filter tabs (Tasbih, Umrah, Hajj steps) measure 32-35px in height. Home retry button measures 75x38px. Search input fields measure 42px height.

findings.title: Missing required aria-checked on role="radio" and prohibited aria-label in Settings modal
findings.expected: Elements with role="radio" must provide aria-checked="true|false". Generic <div> elements without interactive roles must not have aria-label.
findings.actual: In Settings modal, 34 radio options (Theme: System/Dark/Light and Accent color pickers) have role="radio" but omit aria-checked. The backdrop dismissal element <div aria-label="Close settings"> has no role, causing axe aria-prohibited-attr.

findings.title: Search inputs and textareas lack accessible labels across 15 routes
findings.wcag: WCAG 2.1 A 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
findings.route: 15 routes (e.g. quran/home, quran/audio, quran/notes, quran/hifz, quran/surah-list, tools/zakat)
findings.expected: All form input elements and textareas must have an accessible name via <label>, aria-label, or aria-labelledby.
findings.actual: Text inputs and textareas rely solely on the placeholder attribute with no aria-label or associated <label>. Tools/zakat form inputs trigger axe "label" violation.

findings.title: Flat screen-reader heading structure uses multiple H1s without hierarchical levels
findings.wcag: WCAG 2.1 A 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, WCAG 2.4.6 Headings and Labels
findings.expected: Page has one primary h1 heading followed by logically nested h2 and h3 subheadings.
findings.actual: All 52 routes render multiple <h1> elements for individual section dividers (e.g. "KNOWLEDGE & COLLECTIONS", "GUIDES & EDUCATION" on Home are both <h1>) with no hierarchy.

findings.title: Primary interactive feed cards not reachable via keyboard Tab traversal
findings.expected: All interactive items (feed cards, action buttons) are navigable using the Tab key.
findings.actual: Pressable cards rendered with TouchableOpacity lack explicit tabindex="0" on web. Tabbing skips feed cards and only focuses the Retry button and FloatingNav tabs.

findings.title: Zero compiled prefers-reduced-motion CSS rules in web bundle
findings.expected: Web bundle includes @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rules to suppress non-essential animations and transitions.
findings.actual: reduced-motion-audit.json confirms prefersReducedMotion matches true in browser, but 0 CSS media rules for reduced motion exist in bundled stylesheets.

findings.title: Text scaling at 130% exhibits text clipping in compact header bars
findings.expected: Content and text scale to 130% without clipping, truncation, or horizontal scrollbar emergence.
findings.actual: No page horizontal overflow occurs (clientWidth === scrollWidth), but compact header subtitles and pill badges clip text under 130% zoom (1 clipped element in library, quran/home, and quran/reader).

findings.title: AdhanReciterModal contains nested interactive elements (buttons inside touchables)
findings.expected: Interactive controls must not be nested inside other interactive controls.
findings.actual: AdhanReciterModal renders audio preview play buttons directly inside touchable reciter selection rows, triggering axe nested-interactive across 10 nodes.

findings.title: Four modals/alerts blocked from runtime audit by platform or session constraints
findings.expected: All 9 inventory dialogs can be audited in live browser session.
findings.actual: LocationSetupModal::Alert is Android native Alert.alert; AudioPlayerModal requires native expo-av stream; WomenConsentModal is unmounted component superseded by inline consent; WomenPinModal requires local PIN enrollment.

sheetsDialogs.expected: Settings sheet renders with role="dialog", aria-modal="true", keyboard focus trapped within modal, no axe serious/critical violations.
sheetsDialogs.actual: Settings dialog renders with role="dialog" and aria-modal="true". Focus is trapped within modal. Axe detects CRITICAL aria-required-attr (34 radio buttons missing aria-checked) and SERIOUS aria-prohibited-attr (backdrop div with aria-label has no interactive role). Multiple theme radio options measure < 44px height.

sheetsDialogs.expected: Location setup modal provides accessible title, role="dialog", aria-modal="true", minimum 44px close target, and accessible names for all choices.
sheetsDialogs.actual: Rendered with aria-modal="true", but fails WCAG: axe reports SERIOUS aria-dialog-name (dialog lacks accessible name) and SERIOUS color-contrast on body copy. Top-right close button bounding box is 32x32px (< 44px target size).

sheetsDialogs.expected: Native Android Alert.alert provides accessible permission rationale prompt on Android.
sheetsDialogs.actual: Alert.alert location rationale is an Android-only native dialog. In web runtime, Platform.OS === "web" bypasses Alert.alert and resolves true immediately per src/lib/firstLaunchPermissions.ts:51. Runtime evaluation on web target is BLOCKED.

sheetsDialogs.expected: Language picker dialog renders with role="dialog", aria-modal="true", accessible title, search input label, and 44px row targets.
sheetsDialogs.actual: Language picker dialog mounts with role="dialog" and aria-modal="true". Title "APP LANGUAGE (6)" is announced. Search input lacks explicit <label> (relies on placeholder). Axe flags color contrast on sub-captions.

sheetsDialogs.expected: Quran language/translation picker renders with role="dialog", aria-modal="true", valid ARIA attributes, and 44px targets.
sheetsDialogs.actual: Quran language dialog mounts with role="dialog" and aria-modal="true". Axe flags CRITICAL aria-allowed-attr, SERIOUS aria-dialog-name, and inherits Settings radio aria-required-attr (missing aria-checked). Search input lacks label.

sheetsDialogs.expected: Adhan reciter picker dialog renders with role="dialog", aria-modal="true", and no nested interactive elements.
sheetsDialogs.actual: Adhan reciter dialog mounts with role="dialog" and aria-modal="true". Axe flags SERIOUS nested-interactive on 10 reciter row buttons (nested pressables/audio previews inside touchable container), plus SERIOUS aria-dialog-name.

sheetsDialogs.expected: Full-screen audio player modal opens from MiniPlayer or QuranAudio screen with playback controls >= 44px and valid accessible labels.
sheetsDialogs.actual: AudioPlayerModal is conditioned on active audio playback (playback !== null) and user tap on MiniPlayer in App.tsx:1384. In headless web runtime without native audio device, expo-av playback fails to initialize, blocking modal invocation.

sheetsDialogs.expected: Women consent dialog renders as accessible modal when women worship features are enabled.
sheetsDialogs.actual: Component exists in src/components/WomenConsentModal.tsx, but SettingsScreen uses an inline consent block (styles.inlineConsent, SettingsScreen.tsx:1696) to prevent web modal stacking bugs. Standalone modal is never invoked in active app navigation.

sheetsDialogs.expected: PIN setup and verification modal opens with numeric pad, role="dialog", and focus trap.
sheetsDialogs.actual: PIN modal trigger requires biometric or PIN security enrollment in SettingsScreen.tsx:1780. In automated unauthenticated web audit session, local security enrollment is not established, blocking PIN modal invocation.
